sottotitolo: Who books the visits, who carries them out and how many children enrol. The period is read on the date of the visit.
periodoNonValido: The first day cannot come after the last one.
erroreGenerico: The statistics cannot be read. Please try again shortly.
erroreOffline: You are offline: the statistics cannot be read until the connection is back.
cardPresentazioneSub: visits held out of those concluded
tabellaDescrizione: Statistics for each person of the location over the chosen period
tabellaVuota: No visit concluded and no follow-up due in the period.
legendaPresentazione: The attendance rate goes to whoever booked the visit. Cancelled visits do not count.
legendaChiusura: The closing rate goes to whoever carried out the last visit before enrolment: each child counts for one person only.
legendaVerificati: Verified enrolments: the enrolment application is linked to the record. Manual enrolments: no application linked.
legendaRichiami: Follow-ups measure activity of whoever is in charge, not a judgement of their work. Cancelled ones do not count.
nonAttribuiti: {visite, plural, one {# visit held} other {# visits held}} and {bambini, plural, one {# child} other {# children}} appear in no row, because there is nobody to attribute them to.
confrontoSottotitolo: For the Management only: the same period, location by location.
confrontoDescrizione: Totals for each location over the chosen period
